 every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

Out

التفكيك of Heat 
Transfer Surface in Semi-Modular Air Preheaters
Remove rotor housing basket installation/removal door.

Rotate the rotor to line up the basket opening in the rotor with the basket 
 installation/removal opening in the housing panel.
Unbolt reversible pulley and install on the top side of the movable platform.

Cut loose welds between the rotor 
 structure (diaphragms and rotor shell) and the axial seal bars and the 
 adjustable circumferential basket seal angles.

Hook the "Tugger" cable to the cold side 
 basket cover frame and pull baskets out of rotor . Repeat this step until all 
 baskets have been removed from the layer.
Adjust basket platform to level of next layer and repeat steps 4 and 5.

Repeat steps 4 through 6 until all heat transfer surface is removed from the 
 semi-modular rotor compartment.

Rotate the rotor to the full sector closest to opposite of the last unloaded 
 sector and repeat steps 4 through 7.

Repeat steps 4 through 8 until all heat transfer surface has been removed from 
 the semi-modular rotor.

Unthread the 'Tugger" cable through the 
 pulleys. Unbolt the reversible pulley and install on the bottom side of the 
 movable platform. Thread the "Tugger" 
 cable through pulley's.

If the variation is greater than the .020" ( 0.5 mm) move axial seal plate 
 in or out by use of the adjusters which are located exterior of the air 
 preheater in the main pedestal to obtain the specified clearance

تجاوز

The bypass seals are bolted to the by-pass seal angle which is attached to the 
 connecting plate flange. These seals run from sector plate to sector plate on 
 both the gas and air side at the hot and cold ends. Access to these seals is 
 from the inside of the air preheater. To replace these seals remove the 
 present seals and holding strips. Retain the holding strips for use with the 
 new seals. It may be necessary to burn or twist bolts off to remove seals.

When installing the new seals make sure you have the proper width seals. When 
 installing the new seals make sure that the outer leaves stagger the inner 
 leaves such that the bend slots are not exposed. It will be necessary to trim 
 the seal leaves to fit against the axial seal plates and sector plates. It may 
 also be necessary to trim one or more

Of the outer seal leaves to maintain bolt hole alignment. When installing the 
 new seals it is important that they be correctly positioned on the pin rack 
 and rotor sealing angle to avoid run off during operation. At the cold end, 
 the top of the seal leaves should be 1/2"-1"(13-19mm) from the bottom of the 
 pin rack rail.

Refer to the seal setting chart in this section of the O & M manual for the 
 specified clearance between the bypass seals and sealing surfaces at both the 
 hot and cold end.

sections.text: Rotor Post

It is seldom necessary to replace the rotor post seals. However, if the 
 occasion should arise, remove the present seals which are seal welded to the 
 diaphragms and lugs and grind off the welds

When installing the new seals make sure 4543 you have the correct width seal. 
 The seal for the cold end is wider than the hot end seal.

The seals for each respective end are furnished in four 90 degree sections and 
 are notched to fit over the inboard end of the diaphragms

When installing the rotor post seals make sure you have 1/4" (6mm) clearance 
 between the seal and the horizontal sealing surface. You should also have 
 1/16" (2mm) clearance between the seal and the vertical sealing surface. The 
 seal sections are to be welded at the joints and seal welded to the lugs and 
 diaphragms only.

sections.text:
Replacement of Rotor Guide 
Bearing
Block guide trunnion to prevent movement
استنزاف الزيت من السكن المحمل
disconnect water piping to heat exchanger
Remove bolts which secure bearing housing cover to bearing housing

Using a sling and eye bolts provided for this purpose, remove bearing housing 
 cover along with the oil circulating system with internal discharge and 
 suction lines attached
Remove radial bearing ring
Remove bars which lock bolts that secure locking cap to top of trunnion Loosen bolts and back out 3/8" (9.5 mm).

Remove the pipe plug from the center of the trunnion 
 and connect a hydraulic pressure. ram having 5,000-10,000 psi (170 K/m2 
 - 340 K/m2) capacity. Using 
 hydraulic pressure, break the adapter sleeve loose. After breaking the 
 adapter sleeve loose remove the locking cap bolts and locking cap

Using a sling along with eye bolts in the adapter sleeve remove the adapter 
 sleeve and bearing

Remove the bearing from the adapter sleeve by first removing the SKF lock plate and back off locknut approximately 3/16" (4.8 mm). 
 Hydraulic pressure may now be employed to break bearing loose from sleeve by 
 connecting pressure hose to tapped hole in end of adapter sleeve
Once bearing has broken loose remove locknut and bearing from adapter sleeve
Force new bearing on adapter sleeve using the locknut and simultaneously

Position guide bearing assembly unit over trunnion 
 using sling and eye bolts in adapter sleeve

Lower unit down on trunnion. Install locking cap 
 at top of trunnion.
Reinstall radial bearing ring

Install housing cover and circulating system making sure that packing under 
 cover is in proper position
Fill housing to proper level with recommended lubricant

تجاوز
The bypass seals are bolted to the by-pass seal angle which is attached to the 
 connecting plate flange. These seals run from sector plate to sector plate on 
 both the gas and air side at the hot and cold ends. Access to these seals is 
 from the inside of the air preheater. To replace these seals remove the 
 present seals and holding strips. Retain the holding strips for use with the 
 new seals. It may be necessary to burn or twist bolts off to remove seals.
When installing the new seals make sure you have the proper width seals. When 
 installing the new seals make sure that the outer leaves stagger the inner 
 leaves such that the bend slots are not exposed. It will be necessary to trim 
 the seal leaves to fit against the axial seal plates and sector plates. It may 
 also be necessary to trim one or more
Of the outer seal leaves to maintain bolt hole alignment. When installing the 
 new seals it is important that they be correctly positioned on the pin rack 
 and rotor sealing angle to avoid run off during operation. At the cold end, 
 the top of the seal leaves should be 1/2"-1"(13-19mm) from the bottom of the 
 pin rack rail.
Refer to the seal setting chart in this section of the O & M manual for the 
 specified clearance between the bypass seals and sealing surfaces at both the 
 hot and cold end.

Rotor Post
It is seldom necessary to replace the rotor post seals. However, if the 
 occasion should arise, remove the present seals which are seal welded to the 
 diaphragms and lugs and grind off the welds
When installing the new seals make sure 4543 you have the correct width seal. 
 The seal for the cold end is wider than the hot end seal.
The seals for each respective end are furnished in four 90 degree sections and 
 are notched to fit over the inboard end of the diaphragms
When installing the rotor post seals make sure you have 1/4" (6mm) clearance 
 between the seal and the horizontal sealing surface. You should also have 
 1/16" (2mm) clearance between the seal and the vertical sealing surface. The 
 seal sections are to be welded at the joints and seal welded to the lugs and 
 diaphragms only.
